title: apcore Binding File Schema
description: JSON Schema for apcore external binding files (.binding.yaml)

spec_version.description: Declarative config spec version (DECLARATIVE_CONFIG_SPEC.md). Optional in 1.0 with deprecation warning if absent; mandatory in 1.1. Defaults to '1.0' when omitted.

target.description: Target callable path in format 'module.path:callable_name' or 'module.path:ClassName.method_name'. Pattern relaxed in 1.0 to admit TypeScript ESM specifiers (./relative, @scope/pkg) and Rust handler-map keys. SDKs MUST add language-specific security validation (e.g., reject '..' segments). See DECLARATIVE_CONFIG_SPEC.md §2.2.

input_schema.description: Input JSON Schema definition. Required if auto_schema is not true.

output_schema.description: Output JSON Schema definition. Required if auto_schema is not true.

auto_schema.description: Auto-derive schema from target's type declarations. Accepts: true (alias for 'permissive'), 'permissive' (native types as-is), 'strict' (OpenAI/Anthropic strict-schema-compatible: additionalProperties=false, all required, restricted type set). When omitted entirely AND no input_schema/output_schema/schema_ref present, behavior is implicit auto_schema:true (DECLARATIVE_CONFIG_SPEC.md §3.4).

schema_ref.description: Reference to an external Schema file path

version.description: Module version. SemVer format enforced by default policy (apcore.validation.binding.version_require_semver: true) — set to false in apcore.yaml to allow alternative versioning (calver, internal schemes). See DECLARATIVE_CONFIG_SPEC.md §9.

documentation.description: Extended documentation (long-form). Used as fallback when display.documentation is not set.

allOf.comment: Mode mutex: schema_ref excludes everything else.
Mode mutex: auto_schema excludes input/output_schema and schema_ref.
Mode mutex: explicit input_schema requires output_schema and excludes auto_schema and schema_ref.

guidance.description: Surface-specific usage guidance. Overrides display.guidance for this surface only.

DisplayOverlay.description: Display overlay for surface-facing presentation. Sparse: only specified fields override scanner-provided values.

alias.description: Default display name for all surfaces (overrides module_id in presentation). Must be compatible with CLI and MCP constraints when used as cross-surface default.

description.description: Override description for all surfaces. Shown in tool listings and help text. Should be concise but accurate.

documentation.description: Override extended documentation. Full long-form reference docs for this module.

guidance.description: Usage guidance for both humans and AI: when to use, when NOT to use, common mistakes, parameter tips. Shown in describe output and injected into AI tool context. No length limit — be as detailed as needed for accuracy.

cli.description: CLI surface override. Customizes module exposure for command-line invocation.

alias.description: CLI command name (shell-safe, no dots, no spaces). Recommended ≤40 chars for readability but not enforced.

mcp.description: MCP surface override. Customizes module exposure as an MCP tool.

alias.description: MCP tool name. Hard limit: 64 chars (OpenAI function name spec constraint).

a2a.description: A2A surface override. Customizes module exposure as an A2A skill.

alias.description: A2A skill name. Natural language allowed, no hard length limit.

propertyNames.description: All keys MUST be lowercase snake_case identifiers. Catches typos like 'MCP' or 'CLI'.

additionalProperties.description: Future surfaces (e.g., display.graphql, display.http) validate against the SurfaceOverride contract. See DECLARATIVE_CONFIG_SPEC.md §3.6.

Annotations.description: Module behavior annotations. Hints (not enforced constraints) to help AI/LLM make invocation decisions. MUST be kept structurally identical to module-meta.schema.json's Annotations definition — both describe the same module's annotation contract. Aligned with MCP ToolAnnotations.

readonly.description: Whether the module is read-only (no side effects). true = AI can safely invoke without confirmation.

destructive.description: Whether the module performs destructive operations (e.g., delete/overwrite data). true = AI should warn the user before invoking.

idempotent.description: Whether the module is idempotent. true = repeated calls with same inputs produce no additional side effects. AI can safely retry.

requires_approval.description: Whether human approval is required before invocation. true = AI must ask for user consent before calling.

open_world.description: Whether the module interacts with external systems (APIs, networks, services). true = calls may be slow and depend on external availability.

streaming.description: Whether the module supports streaming output. true = module can emit partial results progressively.

cacheable.description: Whether the module output can be cached. true = identical inputs produce identical outputs within cache_ttl.

cache_ttl.description: Suggested cache duration in seconds. 0 = no caching. Only meaningful when cacheable=true.

cache_key_fields.description: Input fields that determine cache key. null = all input fields are used. Only meaningful when cacheable=true.

paginated.description: Whether the module returns paginated results. true = accepts pagination parameters and returns partial result sets.

pagination_style.description: Pagination strategy. Well-known values: 'cursor', 'offset', 'page'. Custom strategies allowed. Only meaningful when paginated=true.

extra.description: Open extension map for ecosystem-specific or vendor annotation metadata. Keys SHOULD use a <namespace>.<name> form (e.g. 'mcp.category', 'cli.approval_message'). The 'core.*' namespace is reserved. Wire format MUST be a nested object — see PROTOCOL_SPEC §4.4.1.
